updates.note: Reiterated smartphone camera modules capacity ramp-up to 180-190 million units annually by next fiscal.
updates.quote: Finally, the ramp-up of capacity over 2 years has to be taken up to 180 to 190 million, which is as per the original plan.

updates.note: Raised IT business revenue target to INR 15,000 crores to INR 20,000 crores for the next couple of years.
updates.quote: We feel that in next couple of years, this is going to be almost INR 15,000 crore to INR 20,000 crore business for us.

updates.note: Display module facility trials delayed to Q3 FY27.
updates.quote: Display line in our new factory is set up, and the trials are going to happen by Q3.

updates.note: Launch of fully automatic front-loading washing machines delayed to Q3 FY27.
updates.quote: The company is progressing towards the launch of fully automatic front-loading washing machines in Q3 of the current fiscal in Tirupati.

updates.note: Reiterated smartphone volumes for the current fiscal (without Vivo) to be around 33-34 million.
updates.quote: we feel we should be somewhere around 33-34 million. And in this, I am not including the Vivo quantities.

updates.note: Management noted that India's smartphone market declined and volumes were broadly stable instead of growing 20-25% Q-o-Q.
updates.quote: Dixon has demonstrated resilience by sustaining its smartphone manufacturing volume at broadly stable year-on-year levels.

new_promises.statement: IT hardware business revenue is targeted to reach approximately INR 6,000 crores in the current fiscal year.
new_promises.quote: And this year itself we feel confident that we are going to be somewhere around INR 6,000 crores in this business.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall

new_promises.statement: Display business can generate revenues of INR 6,000 crores to INR 7,000 crores when completely ramped up.
new_promises.quote: it can generate revenues of closer to INR 6,000 crores to INR 7,000 crores. A large part of it, of course, will be captive.
new_promises.speaker: Saurabh Gupta

new_promises.statement: Q Tech revenue is targeted to be between INR 2,500 crores and INR 3,000 crores next year.
new_promises.quote: broadly we should be in a kind of a number of almost somewhere between INR 2,500 crores to INR 3,000 odd crores. That is what we should be targeting for.
new_promises.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
